When the default spell is cast, it fans out its seven projectiles in front of the player colored like a rainbow shotgun blast.

'''Description:''' Shoots seven rainbow-colored projectiles at even angles. Possibly for distinguishing them from magic bullets, these projectiles come with 1 point of penetration.
